back.en: Stimulus → receptor → afferent → CNS → efferent → effector → response
back.bm: Rangsangan → reseptor → aferen → SSP → eferen → efektor → gerak balas

back.en: CNS: brain + spinal cord. PNS: cranial and spinal nerves
back.bm: SSP: otak + saraf tunjang. SSPe: saraf kranium dan saraf spina

back.en: Cerebrum: thinking. Cerebellum: balance. Medulla: heartbeat, breathing
back.bm: Serebrum: berfikir. Serebelum: keseimbangan. Medula: degupan jantung, pernafasan

back.en: Impulse → vesicles release neurotransmitter → diffuses across cleft → binds receptors → new impulse
back.bm: Impuls → vesikel membebaskan neurotransmiter → meresap merentasi celah → terikat pada reseptor → impuls baharu

back.en: Voluntary: conscious, cerebrum. Involuntary: automatic (reflexes, heartbeat, peristalsis)
back.bm: Terkawal: sedar, serebrum. Luar kawal: automatik (refleks, degupan jantung, peristalsis)

back.en: Receptor → afferent → interneurone (spinal cord) → efferent → effector
back.bm: Reseptor → aferen → neuron perantaraan (saraf tunjang) → eferen → efektor

back.en: Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, multiple sclerosis, attention deficit, damage from drug abuse
back.bm: Alzheimer, Parkinson, sklerosis berbilang, gangguan kurang daya tumpuan, kerosakan akibat penyalahgunaan dadah

back.en: Ductless gland that secretes hormones directly into the blood
back.bm: Kelenjar tanpa duktus yang merembes hormon terus ke dalam darah

back.en: 'Master gland': growth hormone, TSH, FSH, LH, ADH
back.bm: 'Kelenjar induk': hormon pertumbuhan, TSH, FSH, LH, ADH

back.en: Nervous: fast, short, impulses in neurones. Endocrine: slow, long-lasting, hormones in blood
back.bm: Saraf: pantas, singkat, impuls dalam neuron. Endokrin: perlahan, tahan lama, hormon dalam darah

back.en: Fatty layer around the axon that insulates it and speeds up impulses (they jump between nodes of Ranvier)
back.bm: Lapisan lemak di sekeliling akson yang menebat dan mempercepat impuls (impuls melompat antara nodus Ranvier)

back.en: Hormone from the thyroid gland that controls metabolic rate; needs iodine
back.bm: Hormon daripada kelenjar tiroid yang mengawal kadar metabolisme; memerlukan iodin

back.en: From the adrenal glands in "fight or flight": raises heart rate, breathing rate and blood glucose
back.bm: Daripada kelenjar adrenal semasa "lawan atau lari": meningkatkan kadar denyutan jantung, kadar pernafasan dan glukosa darah

example.en: Your heart pounds before a big exam or a race.
example.bm: Jantung berdebar sebelum peperiksaan besar atau perlumbaan.
